_note: Hand-counted truth. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Counts are in COUNTING UNITS (see cv/labels.py): a bunch of coriander is 1, a punnet of strawberries is 1. The number of berries inside is count_visible, not the count.

_bos.jpeg_visible_contents._why: Contents of containers, for reference. Surface estimates only - the jar and punnet hide what is underneath, so treat as a floor.
_bos.jpeg_visible_contents._hard_case: The 3 red round fruits on the top shelf. A human hedged between apples and nectarines; the model has said radish and tomato.
